name: ColourPicker
summary: A colour chosen by eye or by number, as in a design tool's inspector: a saturation and brightness area, a hue slider, a separate opacity slider over a checkerboard, the numbers in one of five models (HSL first), a pick-from-screen button where the browser has one, and swatches. Inline as a panel, or (`trigger`) as a swatch that opens it in a popover, the way fields use it. Not for choosing among a few named colours (a RadioGroup of swatches) or for a theme's brand colours (the colour config).
a11y: The area, hue and opacity are each a `role="slider"` with a spoken value ("saturation 60%, brightness 40%", "hue 210°", "opacity 80%") and keys; the numbers are NumberFields and TextFields named by the picker's label; each swatch is a button named by its hex. Colour is never the only cue: every value is also a number. As a trigger, the swatch is a button named "label: hex" with `aria-haspopup="dialog"`; the popover is a dialog named by the label; Escape closes it and puts focus back on the swatch.

keys.action: Left and Right change saturation, Up and Down brightness (Shift: ten)
arrows by one (Shift: ten), Page Up and Page Down by a tenth, Home and End to the ends

props.name: label
props.description: Names what the colour is for: "Fill colour". Every part's accessible name starts with it.

props.name: alpha
props.description: Opacity, 0–1. Omit it for a colour with no opacity: the opacity slider and field don't show.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Every change, live while dragging: the colour and, with `alpha`, its opacity.

props.name: model
props.description: The model the numbers show in first: HSL by default (owner, Q49). The person can switch it.

props.name: swatches
props.description: Colours to choose with one click, each group titled ("On this page", "Saved").

props.name: trigger
props.description: Shows a swatch button instead of the panel; pressing it opens the panel in a popover under it (Escape or a press outside closes it). The swatch fills the box its parent gives it, 20 px at least. `empty` draws no colour (a colour not chosen yet); `disabled` stops it opening.

props.name: beside
props.description: With `trigger` (LR46): the swatches sit in a row before the swatch button and the pick-from-screen button (where the browser has one) after it, each a target in size, instead of inside the panel. A swatch or a pick is a finished choice (`onClose` follows `onChange`).

props.name: pickLabel
props.description: The pick-from-screen button's name when it sits beside: default "Pick a colour from the screen".

props.name: onClose
props.description: With `trigger`: the popover closed, so the person has finished choosing (save here, not on every live change).
